page.title: Mail
page.subtitle: SMTP on 127.0.0.1:{port}
clear.title: Clear the inbox?
clear.body: Every mail the sink holds is dropped. This can't be undone.
empty.none.title: No mail yet
empty.none.body: Point your app's SMTP settings at 127.0.0.1:{port}. No sign-in or TLS is needed. Mail sent there shows up here, and the last 200 are kept.
empty.no_matches.title: No matching mail
detail.none.title: No mail selected
detail.none.body: Pick a mail to read it.
detail.gone.title: This mail is gone
detail.gone.body: The sink keeps the last 200 mails and dropped this one to make room.
error.change_port: The port can be changed in Settings.
